finding_summary: Ran dpkg -V to compare installed files against original package checksums. Found 9095 file(s) with drift. Each one is either a legitimate local config change, OR a real integrity concern if it's a binary that was never meant to be edited post-install — worth reviewing each entry individually. (debsums not installed — dpkg -V alone only checks metadata like permissions/ownership for many packages, not full file content hashes; consider installing debsums for a stronger check)
